adventure: SWE02 Long Arm of the Hutt

implementation.feature: B’ura arranges safe Krayt Fang docking before any Nabat local services
implementation.ui: SWE02 arrival choices ship-safe-landing / ship-thwheek-to-nabat / ship-crash-to-nabat
implementation.persistence: A source-p13 NABAT_SAFE_DOCKING receipt records exactly one verified route (no interception, Thwheek landed, or crash crew resolved); local repair, market, watch, and care require that receipt. Reopen and tamper validation are included.
implementation.limitations: Fuel quantity and price are not specified by the adventure and remain unmodified.

implementation.feature: Optional transponder removal can be attempted after Nabat landing
implementation.persistence: The p.13 arrival choice enters the actual ground-inspection state; the source-p.8 Average Mechanics roll records removal on success, and the saved flag/source check survive three controller reopen cycles.
implementation.limitations: The p.13 scene offers the opportunity; difficulty and mechanic remain sourced to p.8. Fuel, market completeness, actual Android PDF import and page-wide proof remain open.
Catalog intentionally restricts purchases to individually sourced EotE Core entries. Weapons currently use an AoR reference source and remain excluded until EotE crosswalk is verified.

implementation.feature: Printed p.13 Nabat geography, market approach and militant safehouse scene
implementation.persistence: The current adventure node is saved; reopening the controller derives the matching source-backed scene again. Market inventory remains catalog-derived and the <=500 credit item limit is enforced in deterministic code.
implementation.limitations: Narrative scene assertions and HTML presence are tested; a visual Android screen review and installed-PDF import are not yet evidenced. Full p.13 certification remains pending.

implementation.feature: B'ura B'an's contacts pay for any needed Krayt Fang repairs
implementation.persistence: VEHICLES_UPDATED + WORLD_UPDATED atomicAction; repairs actual hull damage, system strain and repairable criticals; clears disabled components; retains repaired critical history; receipt records before/after state and Nabat contact payer; no currency is deducted
implementation.limitations: Nabat contacts restore the actual ship state when it can be repaired; unrecoverable destroyed/vaporized ships are rejected. Fuel quantities or prices remain unmodified because the source gives no numeric amount.

implementation.feature: Optional player-requested spaceport warning; human and Gand visitors
implementation.limitations: The alert is not automatic; it requires the player request and a later explicit delivery.

implementation.feature: Nyn safehouse heals normal wounds and strain for every PC
implementation.controller: GameController.treatSWE02NabatPartyCare (all roster PCs atomically); treatSWE02NabatWounds (active-PC compatibility route)
implementation.persistence: PLAYER_ROSTER_UPDATED + WORLD_UPDATED atomicAction; one unique SAFEHOUSE_CARE receipt per registered PC ID; group action requires roster size to match session playerCount and rejects combat; reload validation checks stable patient ID, integer effect counts and pending critical care; reopen confirms every treated PC
implementation.limitations: The physician's separate Critical Injury attempt is in P241 via swe02SocialP241.mjs:nynCriticalCare and can target a non-active roster PC using the same roster ID. Fuel quantity/pricing and remaining page-wide source proof stay open.
